caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, rain and puddle sound effects, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, playful, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Pitter patter! It's raining!

[Chorus]
Pitter patter, rain is falling,
Puddles, puddles, they are calling!
Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!

[Verse]
Rory has a big umbrella,
Red and round for a lion fella!
Spin it, spin it, one, two, three,
Rory stays dry as dry can be!

[Chorus]
Pitter patter, rain is falling,
Puddles, puddles, they are calling!
Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!

[Verse]
Ziggy wears her purple boots,
And a raincoat with a hood that's cute!
Tip toe, tip toe, one, two, three,
Ziggy hops so carefully!

[Chorus]
Pitter patter, rain is falling,
Puddles, puddles, they are calling!
Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!

[Verse]
Waffles finds the biggest puddle,
Splash! Now he's in a muddy muddle!
Splash, splash, one, two, three,
Waffles laughs, hee hee hee!

[Chorus]
Pitter patter, rain is falling,
Puddles, puddles, they are calling!
Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!

[Verse]
Pebble loves the rain the most,
He slides along from coast to coast!
Slide, slide, one, two, three,
Pebble's whizzing happily!

[Bridge]
Look up high, the rain has gone,
The sun comes out to shine upon,
A rainbow arching in the sky,
Wave to the clouds and say goodbye!

[Chorus]
Pitter patter, rain is falling,
Puddles, puddles, they are calling!
Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!

[Chorus]
Pitter patter, rain is falling,
Puddles, puddles, they are calling!
Jump in, splash out, one, two, three,
Rainy day fun for you and me!

[Outro]
What a splashy day! Bye bye, friends!
